text: stricken in years: Heb. entered into days
let there be sought: Heb. let them seek | a young virgin: Heb. a damsel, a virgin | cherish him: Heb. be a cheriser unto him
at any time: Heb. from his days
conferred with Joab: Heb. his words were with Joab | following Adonijah, helped him: Heb. helped after Adonijah
what wouldest thou?: Heb. what to thee?
God save king Adonijah: Heb. let king Adonijah live
into the king's presence: Heb. before the king
mine own: Heb. which belongeth to me
